about_the_game:
Way Of Animals: This World Will Show You the Way that Animals Surviv

Way Of Animals was created and designed for players who are looking for a place to feel like the leader, the protector, the one who guides the herd, a place where you can be the best in the entire African savannah.

Great Multiplayer System

Explore a vast environmental protection reserve called Crater. A place where several different species can coexist in total freedom. Be careful, not all the animals that live here are peaceful, some are just waiting for the most opportune moment to make their attack.

Life Cycle System

Live and survive from the smallest of the Crater's inhabitants and progress with our Life Cycle System until you become the strongest and most dominant species.

Danger is Everywhere

Be prepared for surprise attacks, danger lurks behind every rock. Your cubs will need all your skills to protect them.

Great PVP

Join forces with friends to take down on bigger prey.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 3.0 GHZ.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280X series card.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct X Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD processor, 3.0 GHZ.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Way Of Animals is a game where you have to survive the dangers and challenges of the African savannah in the shoes of different animals. Protect your herd from the dangers of the night. Heat and drought are also your enemies. Survive, if you can.
